summary: This stylesheet styles a row of article actions—specifically a copy button and a raw link—that sit together as a tightly-grouped pair. The wrapper uses flexbox to line them up with minimal spacing, while both the button and link are styled identically on purpose so they read as a cohesive family rather than unrelated controls.

explanations.16: inline-flex makes the wrapper shrink to fit its children horizontally instead of taking the full width, so the action buttons sit snugly together.
explanations.18: gap: 8px puts 8 pixels of space between the button and link—tighter than the surrounding row spacing—to visually signal they're a related pair.
explanations.25: var(--mk-ink-soft) is a CSS variable (a named color value) that the project defines elsewhere; it's reused everywhere the same color is needed so changes apply everywhere at once.
explanations.37: :not(:disabled) means 'apply this hover style only if the button is not disabled,' so disabled buttons stay visually muted even if you hover over them.
explanations.47: This link is styled to look like a button on purpose—same padding, border, and font size as .copyBtn—so users see it as one control alongside the copy button, not as a regular link.
explanations.58: text-decoration: none removes the underline that links normally have, keeping it looking button-like instead of like a traditional hyperlink.
